findings.where: venue night_market_firefly_lane review 1 ('the owner's teenage son does his homework at the far end of the counter')
findings.issue: Cyrus's reworked peanut line ends with 'The far end of the counter isn't far enough.' The answer's review is now the only place in the results that uses the same phrase. That's harmless as a fact, but an attentive player may read the phrase match as a wink toward Firefly Lane. It could also briefly seem to tie Firefly Lane to Cyrus's peanut worry.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the son elsewhere, e.g. 'the owner's teenage son does his homework on an upturned crate behind the cart between orders.' (Stone Well already uses a crate, so 'at a folding stool by the herb boxes' also works.)

findings.where: venue night_market_firefly_lane review 2 ('peanuts simply aren't stocked anywhere on the cart, dips and frying oil included')
findings.issue: The peanut evidence is now firm and matches Cyrus's 'tucked away in the back' bar. It doesn't single out the answer: Stone Well, Twelve Bells, Plum Bridge and Red Thread are all just as clearly peanut-safe, and Red Thread and Stone Well are just as explicit. Three small rough edges remain. 'frying oil' tells the player the healthy answer has a fryer, which rubs slightly against Brooke's fryer line. The flat statement is plainer than the implied style asks for. 'allergy pen' repeats Twelve Bells review 2's 'allergy pen for peanuts'.
findings.suggested_fix: e.g. '...from a big jar the owner keeps where other carts keep their peanut tub. I asked about the dips and dressings too, and she ran through every one without a peanut in sight. A summer of Friday nights later, my epinephrine has never left my bag.'

findings.where: script[14] (Cyrus: 'Good. Then wherever we land will have plenty of options for Mina.')
findings.issue: The line no longer echoes level_08 or brushes the level_16 'real main' wording, which is good. But 'will have' reads as a prediction (any viet stall will do) more than a requirement, even though Liam just said only half the row has tofu. Mina's reply 'only if it's easy!' answers a plan, not a prediction. The clue is still findable through Liam's and Mina's lines; this would just make the bar sharper.
findings.suggested_fix: Cyrus: 'Good. Then wherever we land needs plenty of options for Mina.'

findings.where: script[17] (Brooke: '...i want a dinner that feels light and clean')
findings.issue: The hot-night reason is fresh, fits chapter 3's late-summer calendar, and is one clear wish (Liam's fryer line only confirms it). But 'light and clean' is close to Brooke's 'light and fresh, please' from level_11, a stated level, one level ago. Her perfect line 'light, bright and just right' also follows level_11's 'fresh, light'.
findings.suggested_fix: e.g. Brooke: 'speaking of which: it's way too warm tonight for anything heavy. i want the kind of dinner you could eat and then go for a walk'

summary: Every earlier finding the rework targeted is resolved. Cyrus's new peanut line is properly implied and still sets a findable 'no peanuts anywhere' bar: Brooke's tub warning is answered with 'on the counter or tucked away in the back', and he never says 'allergy'. The new Firefly Lane peanut review doesn't give the answer away, because four other venues are equally peanut-safe, and veg (Stone Well) and healthy (Twelve Bells) still decide the puzzle. Brooke's hot-night reason, Liam's new Plum Bridge line and the Red Thread rewording all land. The remaining notes are polish: a phrase echo between Cyrus's line and the answer's review, 'frying oil' at the healthy answer, Cyrus's 'will have' reading as a prediction, and Brooke's 'light and clean' sitting close to level_11.
